General Post Office.
18 April 1935.

Miss Siassmore.

With reference to your telephonic inquiry this afternoon regarding a Professor K... residing at 24 Calthorpe Street, W.C., I have ascertained without instituting a list that the name of the man is Karl Korst. N.T.

C.E. Powell
